scripts.build: npm run build -w @sperger/shared && npm run build -w @sperger/api && npm run build -w @sperger/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @sperger/shared && npm run build -w @sperger/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @sperger/shared && TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=1 TS_NODE_COMPILER_OPTIONS='{"module":"commonjs","moduleResolution":"node","esModuleInterop":true}' node --require ts-node/register --test packages/shared/src/*.test.ts 'apps/api/test/*.test.ts'
